headerDisplay: Plugin for AlarmDecoder (Honeywell/DSC) and Interlogix/GE/Caddx alarm panels. Requires a running AlarmDecoder WebApp or NX584 gateway.

port.title: Listener Port
port.description: Port that Homebridge will listen on for push notifications from AlarmDecoder WebApp.

zoneURL.title: Zone URL
zoneURL.description: URL to query zone configuration (e.g. http://YOUR_IP:YOUR_PORT/api/v1/zones).

setPIN.title: PIN
setPIN.description: Your alarm PIN (base PIN only, e.g. '1234' not '12342').

key.title: API Key
key.description: API key from the AlarmDecoder WebApp (Honeywell/DSC only).

enableNightMode.title: Enable Night Mode
enableNightMode.description: Show Night/Instant arm mode in HomeKit. Disable if your panel does not support it.

useSwitches.title: Extra Switches
useSwitches.description: Create additional HomeKit switches for quick arming or special functions. Note: away/stay/night switches bypass the HomeKit security prompt.

panicKey.title: Panic Key
panicKey.description: Keypad sequence to trigger panic (e.g. '<S1>'). Honeywell/DSC only.

chimeKey.title: Chime Key
chimeKey.description: Keypad key for chime toggle (e.g. '9'). Honeywell/DSC only.

offKey.title: Off/Clear Key
offKey.description: Keypad key appended to PIN for the clear command (default: '1').

DSCStay.title: DSC Stay Sequence
DSCStay.description: DSC key sequence for Stay arm (e.g. '<F4>').

DSCAway.title: DSC Away Sequence
DSCAway.description: DSC key sequence for Away arm (e.g. '<S5>').
